terms.metaDescription: Terms and conditions for using Swibook, the frictionless booking calendar.
terms.title: Terms & conditions

sections.title: 1. Acceptance
sections.body: By using Swibook (website, app, or booking storefront) you accept these terms. If you disagree, do not use the service.

sections.title: 2. What Swibook is
sections.body: Swibook is a platform for booking appointments: public link, schedule, team, and client messaging. The product may evolve; we will communicate material changes when appropriate.

sections.title: 3. Your account and business
sections.body: You are responsible for the information you publish (services, prices, hours, images) and for fulfilling the bookings you receive. You must be entitled to offer those services and comply with applicable rules for your craft.

sections.title: 4. Acceptable use
sections.body: Use Swibook lawfully and respectfully. Abuse, identity fraud, interference with the platform, or illegal or deceptive use is not allowed.

sections.title: 5. Bookings and client relationships
sections.body: The commercial relationship is between you and your client. Swibook enables scheduling; it is not a party to the service contract you offer unless stated otherwise in writing.

sections.title: 6. Availability
sections.body: We aim for 24/7 availability, but maintenance, outages, or errors may occur. Uninterrupted availability is not guaranteed.

sections.title: 7. Intellectual property
sections.body: Swibook, its brand, design, and software belong to their owners. You keep rights to content you upload; you grant us a limited license to operate it inside the service.

sections.title: 8. Limitation of liability
sections.body: To the extent permitted by law, Swibook is not liable for lost profits, data loss, or indirect damages arising from use of — or inability to use — the service.

sections.title: 9. Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms. The update date appears above. Continued use after changes means acceptance.

sections.title: 10. Contact
sections.body: Questions about these terms: hola@swibook.app.

privacy.metaDescription: How Swibook handles personal data for businesses and people who book.
privacy.title: Privacy policy

sections.title: 1. Who we are
sections.body: Swibook operates the booking calendar and storefront at swibook.sibylab.com and related domains. Contact: hola@swibook.app.

sections.title: 2. Data we process
sections.body: We may process account data (name, email, business), schedule data (appointments, services, booking clients), technical data (IP, device, logs), and information you send via support or contact.

sections.title: 3. Why we use it
sections.body: To provide booking, maintain your account, improve the product, send operational notices, and meet legal duties. We do not sell your data to third parties for unrelated marketing.

sections.title: 4. Legal bases and processors
sections.body: We process data to perform the service contract and, where applicable, for legitimate interests (security, improvement) or consent. We may use infrastructure and messaging providers under processing agreements.

sections.title: 5. End customers
sections.body: If a business uses Swibook, that business is responsible for its clients’ data. Swibook acts as technology processor/platform as applicable. The business must inform its clients as required by law.

sections.title: 6. Retention
sections.body: We keep data while the account is active and as needed for legal, dispute, or security purposes, then delete or anonymize when appropriate.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.body: You may request access, correction, deletion, or objection under applicable law. Email hola@swibook.app. You may also opt out of non-essential communications.

sections.title: 8. Cookies
sections.body: The site may use technical cookies and, where applicable, measurement cookies. You can control cookies in your browser; some are required for the site to work.

sections.title: 9. Security
sections.body: We apply reasonable security measures. No system is 100% secure; please protect your credentials.

sections.title: 10. Changes
sections.body: We may update this policy. The update date will appear on this page.
